subject: Purchase reference derivation, ledger repair & temporary spend-cap rollback
messages:
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Ellis Moreno <ellis.moreno@harbortek.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Purchase reference derivation, ledger repair & temp spend-cap ask

Hi Ellis —

Thanks for the quick onboarding packet last week. We're almost across the finish line but hit two blockers while assigning the official purchase reference on our side:

1) The provisional PO you provided (PO-1347-PROV) generated multiple purchase-token candidates in our ledger; the SKU mapping you supplied doesn't contain the vendor SKU column we use to deterministically derive the Purchase Reference. That is causing duplicates in our upstream allocations.
2) The spend cap in your original onboarding (USD 120k / month) was applied at the profile level but your legal procurement team later indicated a hard cap at the department line-item level (USD 95k). Our provisioning flow can't reconcile those two inputs, so requests are either failing or being stashed into the provisional queue.

Can you please:
- Re-send the SKU mapping with the vendor SKU column (or confirm which field we should use as the canonical vendor SKU).
- Confirm whether Harbortek wants the 120k global cap or the 95k departmental cap to be enforced in production. If you need the lower cap we can push a temporary rollback on our side while we re-issue the definitive PO.

I've looped in Monica (procurement ops) who can run the ledger repair once we have the corrected sheet. If helpful I've attached the onboarding form we received (harbortek-onboarding-form.pdf) so you can see which fields are missing on our end.

Thanks — goal is to avoid orphaned line-items in the first billing window.

Sergio Alvarez
Strategic Ops (Vendor Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0198
From: Ellis Moreno <ellis.moreno@harbortek.com>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
Cc: Harbortek Procurement <procurement@harbortek.com>
Date: Fri, 5 Jun 2027 11:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase reference derivation, ledger repair & temp spend-cap ask

Sergio —

Appreciate the heads up. Sorry about the missing vendor SKU column — our intake export was trimmed. I've attached the updated workbook (harbortek-sku-mapping.xlsx) which includes the vendor_sku column you mentioned and a short notes tab with mappings to our internal catalog IDs.

Regarding caps: procurement confirms the intended contractual cap is USD 120k/month but due to an internal billing allocation issue, the department allocated cap was inadvertently set to 95k. Legal will not change the contract; procurement will coordinate an internal reallocation. For now, please do NOT permanently lower the global cap. If you need a temporary hold while we sort our internal allocation, that is fine — we prefer the provisional PO be held in a pending state rather than auto-rejected.

I've also attached the signed onboarding form on our side. Sorry again for the churn. Let me know if the sheet looks clean on your end.

Best,
Ellis Moreno
Senior Procurement Manager
Harbortek
ellis.moreno@harbortek.com
Attachment: harbortek-sku-mapping.xlsx
From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>
To: Ellis Moreno <ellis.moreno@harbortek.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase reference derivation, ledger repair & temp spend-cap ask

Ellis — thanks, the workbook looks good. Quick notes after a pass against our derivation rules:

- The vendor_sku column is clean but two rows (lines 18 and 19) use the same vendor_sku for distinct line descriptions. That will create a collision when we auto-derive a single Purchase Reference for both lines. Please confirm whether those lines should consolidate into a single SKU with quantity aggregation, or remain separate line items with unique vendor SKUs.

- Because procurement confirmed the master contract cap is 120k but your department allocation is 95k, we will:
  * Hold the provisional PO (PO-1347-PROV) in a pending state rather than auto-rejecting;
  * Execute a temporary spend-cap rollback on our staging ledger to prevent automated allocation to the 95k bucket until you confirm reallocation. This requires an approval from our finance steward (Monica) — Monica, can you approve a short-lived rollback (72 hours) and then a ledger repair run once Harbortek confirms final line treatment?

I've attached the onboarding form we received and the cleaned SKU mapping you sent for traceability.

Thanks — if you can reply with decisions on lines 18/19 today we can avoid delaying the June billing window.

Sergio
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.inference>
To: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.inference>, Ellis Moreno <ellis.moreno@harbortek.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.inference>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Purchase reference derivation, ledger repair & temp spend-cap ask

Thanks all — granting the temporary rollback. Operational plan below:

1) Immediate: I will flip the provisioning policy for account HB-2027-1347 to respect the contract-level cap (120k) and suspend department-level enforcement for 72 hours. That will move PO-1347-PROV out of the auto-reject queue and into pending.

2) Line-item fix: Sergio / Grace will run the ledger repair after Harbortek confirms how lines 18/19 should be treated. If Ellis confirms they are distinct SKUs we'll require a corrected vendor_sku value for one of the lines. If they should collapse, we'll aggregate quantities and issue a single Purchase Reference.

3) Finalize: Once Harbortek confirms, we'll re-issue the definitive PO number (PO-1347) and send an amended PO PDF for signature. Ellis — I'll prepare an amended PO and share a DocuSign envelope (link below) for your procurement sign-off; please route to legal afterwards.

DocuSign (amended PO draft): https://app.docusign.com/envelope/0a1b2c3d4e5f
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/DBL-98765

Attachments included: amended-po-1347-draft.pdf (internal draft).

Once Ellis confirms the two lines we'll proceed — I'm running the rollback now.

Monica Patel
Finance & Procurement Steward
Redwood Inference
